engineering_verdict: **Motorola Edge 60 Pro** decisively wins this head-to-head evaluation with a PulseThrottle Index of **85.6/100** vs **Motorola Edge 60 Fusion** at **61.5/100** (+24.1 point advantage). Powered by MediaTek Dimensity 8350 Extreme (4nm TSMC, 1x 3.35 GHz + 3x 3.20 GHz Cortex-A715 + 4x 2.20 GHz Cortex-A510) (ARM Mali-G615 MC6, LPDDR5X RAM, UFS 4.0, AnTuTu v10: 1,385,000 vs 655,000), Motorola Edge 60 Pro provides over 2x the raw GPU shader throughput and faster storage bandwidth for sustained 90fps BGMI workloads. While Motorola Edge 60 Fusion exhibits excellent 3DMark thermal stability (65.0% at 42.4°C), its mid-tier Cortex-A78/UFS 2.2 pipeline caps sustained gaming at 60 FPS. Both panels utilize 720Hz PWM dimming for eye comfort.
